usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight for large titles, tracking-wide for overlines. Weight 700-900.
usage_rules.numbers: Use Barlow Condensed for stats (Match %, Rankings) to feel like a scoreboard.

PageLayout.structure: Container > Header (Title + Search + Actions) > FilterBar > Kanban/Grid Content
PageLayout.guidelines: Use a max-width container (max-w-7xl) centered. Background should be neutral-light/dark, not pure white/black.

FilterBar.interaction: Horizontal scroll on mobile. Active state fills with Primary Color + White Text. Inactive is transparent with Ring border.

structure.header: Left border strip indicating status color. Top row: Logo (left) + Match Score Badge (right).
structure.body: University Name (H3) + Conference (subtitle). Division Badge below name.
structure.interaction: Hover: Lift translateY(-2px) + Shadow-lg. Border color intensifies.

SchoolCard.visuals: White/Dark-Card bg. Subtle border (border-slate-200 / border-slate-700). meaningful whitespace.

Badges.division: Solid background, white text. Bold font. Small text-xs uppercase.
Badges.match_score: Circular or Pill. Ring border for lower visual weight, or soft background (bg-opacity-10) with strong text.

ProgressBar.journey: Step wizard style. Active step is filled circle, future is empty ring. Connecting lines.

layout_strategies.grid_system: Responsive Masonry or Bento Grid. Mobile: 1 col. Tablet: 2 cols. Desktop: 3 or 4 cols.
layout_strategies.group_headers: Sticky headers when scrolling. Distinct typography (Barlow Condensed Uppercase) with pill badge count.

motion.list_transitions: Staggered entrance for cards. Layout LayoutGroup for smooth filtering reordering.

assets.icons: Lucide React (Feather icons). Use thin strokes (1.5px) for elegance.

images.usage: Use generic campus photos for card backgrounds (with heavy overlay) if no logo is present, or for page headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION: Create the 'My Schools' board as a single comprehensive component or set of sub-components in 'src/components/recruiting/'.
2. THEME SUPPORT: Use Tailwind 'dark:' modifiers for ALL color definitions. Ensure contrast passes in both modes.
3. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (filters, buttons, cards).
4. NO MOCK DATA IN PROD: Create a mock data file 'src/data/mockSchools.js' ONLY for demonstration if backend is not ready, but structure it for easy API replacement.
5. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure status colors have text labels, not just color indicators.
6. MICRO-INTERACTIONS: animate the 'Journey' button on hover (e.g., arrow moves right).
7. EMPTY STATES: Design a beautiful empty state for 'No Schools Found' using a light illustration or icon.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects for sticky headers.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
